name: Add a new SaaS without connecting MRR
description: User adds a new SaaS, fills required fields, selects 'Más tarde' provider, and the SaaS is published.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Agrega tu MRR' button to open the SaaS submission modal
Click the provider dropdown and select the 'Más tarde' option
Enter 'SaaS Automator' in the 'Nombre del SaaS' input
Click any category badge in the 'Categorías' selector
Verify the success screen or modal is displayed indicating the SaaS was submitted. Do not verify the SaaS appears in the ranking list, as it requires admin approval.
